You are onboarding a domain into the Nxeon "Business Email" product so it appears in the customer portal dashboard. Work in /opt/nxeon (Next.js + Prisma app; the Prisma client auto-loads .env, and lib/mailcow.ts reads MAILCOW_API_URL/MAILCOW_API_KEY which are configured).

GOAL: Make `soulpilates.com.vn` a Business Email subscription under user `nicholas.sj.albanese@gmail.com` (userId `cmrztujaw0002hlazl58i3lsi`), so it joins revsports.ca and studionexis.com in that account's Business Email list, with mailboxes contact@, admin@, noreply@ and an "unlimited" mailbox plan.

CONTEXT (verified facts):
- Central mail server (Mailcow) is `mail.nxeon.cloud`; it is reachable (mailcowConfigured() returns true).
- Prisma models: `EmailPlan` (fields: name, mailboxes Int cap, storageGB, priceCents, termMonths, active, sortOrder), `EmailSubscription` (userId, domainName, emailPlanId, status, verified, verifyToken, external Boolean, dkimRecord, autoRenew, expiresAt, createdAt), `Mailbox` (subscriptionId, address UNIQUE, passwordEnc, status, quotaMB, ...).
- Existing plans: Starter(1), Business(5), Pro(25). Existing subs: revsports.ca, studionexis.com (both ACTIVE/verified under this user).
- Mailcow helpers in lib/mailcow.ts: `mcDomainExists(domain)`, `mcCreateDomain(domain)`, `mcCreateMailbox({localPart,domain,name,password,quotaMB})`, `mcGetDkim(domain)`. Encryption helper: `encryptSecret` in lib/crypto-box.ts. DNS constants in lib/actions-email-hosting.ts: MAIL_HOST="mail.nxeon.cloud", MX priority 10, SPF_VALUE=`v=spf1 include:nxeon.cloud ~all`, DKIM selector "dkim", DMARC="v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:dmarc@nxeon.cloud".

TASKS:
1. Create an "Unlimited" EmailPlan if none exists: name "Unlimited", mailboxes 9999, storageGB 25, priceCents 0, termMonths 12, active false (internal — not publicly orderable), sortOrder 99. (Direct Prisma insert is fine.)
2. Create the EmailSubscription for `soulpilates.com.vn` under userId cmrztujaw0002hlazl58i3lsi: emailPlanId = the Unlimited plan, status "ACTIVE", autoRenew true, external true, verified false, verifyToken = 24 random hex bytes, expiresAt = now + 12 months. (Skip if a soulpilates.com.vn subscription already exists — just relink it to the Unlimited plan.)
3. Ensure the Mailcow domain exists (mcCreateDomain if not), then create mailboxes contact@, admin@, noreply@soulpilates.com.vn via mcCreateMailbox (quota 25GB each = 25*1024 MB), with strong random passwords; insert a Mailbox row per address (status ACTIVE, passwordEnc = encryptSecret(password)). Skip any address that already has a Mailbox row.
4. Fetch the domain DKIM via mcGetDkim and store it in the subscription's dkimRecord.
5. OUTPUT (this is your return value — structured, exact): the created subscription id; each mailbox address + its plaintext password; and the exact DNS records the domain owner must publish: the `_nxeon-verify.soulpilates.com.vn` TXT value (nxeon-verify=<token>), MX (soulpilates.com.vn → mail.nxeon.cloud pri 10), SPF TXT, DKIM TXT (host `dkim._domainkey.soulpilates.com.vn` + full value), DMARC TXT.

Write your work as a tsx script under /opt/nxeon/scripts/ (named _sp-onboard.ts), run it with `npx tsx`, then delete it. Wrap all logic in an async main() (top-level await is NOT supported — it errors with "Top-level await is currently not supported with cjs").

CONSTRAINTS:
- DATA ONLY. Do NOT edit prisma/schema.prisma, do NOT run prisma migrate/db push, do NOT edit any board files. Another agent owns schema + board code concurrently.
- Do NOT change any DNS (the owner does that). Do NOT modify the Soul Pilates app on the 51.79.226.200 box (its SMTP switch happens later, after DNS verifies — not your job).
- If a safety classifier blocks a command (you'll see "Blocked by classifier"), do NOT try to circumvent it maliciously — report exactly which command was blocked and stop; that becomes part of your final report.

Return: a concise structured report — what was created (plan/subscription/mailboxes), the DNS records table, mailbox passwords, and any blocked/failed steps.

/**

 *
 * WHY. `prorateDeltaCents` used to default its rate basis to `currentPromo(now)`,
 * so a resize was priced off whatever seasonal promo happened to be running when
 * the customer clicked — letting them upgrade under a 45% basis and downgrade under
 * a 15% one and keep the spread on every remaining month. The fix records the rate
 * each term was ACTUALLY sold at on the server row. Rows that predate the column

 *

 *
 *   1. free / no expiry      -> 100 (gifted; nothing was sold, nothing prorates)

 *   5. otherwise             -> the conservative fallback (see below)
 *
 * Rules 3 and 4 read what the customer was genuinely billed. Both an order and a
 * renewal write their description from the same templates the code still uses:
